sentences.text: Joshua Daniel `` Josh '' Hartnett -LRB- born July 21 , 1978 -RRB- is an American actor and movie producer .
He first came to attention in 1997 for his role as Michael Fitzgerald in the television crime drama series Cracker .	Cracker	Cracker (U.S. TV series)

He made his feature film debut in 1998 in the slasher film Halloween H20 : 20 Years Later , followed by teen roles in films such as the sci-fi horror film The Faculty -LRB- 1998 -RRB- and the drama The Virgin Suicides -LRB- 1999 -RRB- .	The Faculty	The Faculty	The Virgin Suicides	The Virgin Suicides (film)

Hartnett had starring roles in the war film Pearl Harbor , the drama O , the war film Black Hawk Down , the romantic comedy 40 Days and 40 Nights , and other films .	Pearl Harbor	Pearl Harbor (film)	O	O (film)	Black Hawk Down	Black Hawk Down (film)	40 Days and 40 Nights	40 Days and 40 Nights

Jackson , the graphic novel -- based vampire horror film 30 Days of Night -LRB- 2007 -RRB- and the neo-noir atmospheric thriller I Come with the Rain -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .
